copy.headline: ‘Everything is under control' after fire at Aerospace facility: Weatherford fire chief
copy.caption: The city of Weatherford lifted a shelter-in-place order on Wednesday morning after a two alarm fire at Weatherford Aerospace. No one was hurt and the cause of the fire is under investigation.
